news.title: Connor scores twice and the Jets beat the Islanders 3-1 for 3rd straight win
news.ruTitle: Connor scores twice and the Jets beat the Islanders 3-1 for 3rd straight win
news.description: — Kyle Connor had two goals and an assist and the Winnipeg Jets extended their winning streak to three games with a 3-1 victory over the New York Islanders on Friday night.

news.title: Mangiapane scores twice, Knight makes 30 saves to help Blackhawks edge Rangers 2-1
news.ruTitle: Mangiapane scores twice, Knight makes 30 saves to help Blackhawks edge Rangers 2-1
news.description: — Andrew Mangiapane scored two power-play goals in the first period, Spencer Knight made 30 saves and the Chicago Blackhawks held off the New York Rangers 2-1 on Friday night for their fourth straight victory.

news.title: Makar gets shootout winner as Avalanche overcome 3-goal, 3rd-period deficit to beat Wild 4-3
news.ruTitle: Makar gets shootout winner as Avalanche overcome 3-goal, 3rd-period deficit to beat Wild 4-3
news.description: — Cale Makar was the lone scorer in the shootout, and the Colorado Avalanche rallied from a three-goal deficit in the third period for a 4-3 victory over the Minnesota Wild on Friday.

news.title: Sharks beat Vegas 4-1 for franchise’s first regulation win over Golden Knights at SAP Center
news.ruTitle: Sharks beat Vegas 4-1 for franchise’s first regulation win over Golden Knights at SAP Center
news.description: — Yaroslav Askarov made 27 saves and the San Jose Sharks beat Vegas 4-1 on Friday for the franchise’s first regulation victory over the Golden Knights at SAP Center.

news.title: Mats Zuccarello, Andre Lee lead LA Kings past Ducks 5-3 in first Freeway Faceoff of season
news.ruTitle: Mats Zuccarello, Andre Lee lead LA Kings past Ducks 5-3 in first Freeway Faceoff of season
news.description: — Mats Zuccarello scored two goals, Andre Lee got the tiebreaking goal early in the third period and the Los Angeles Kings beat the Anaheim Ducks 5-3 Friday in the first Freeway Faceoff rivalry game of the season.

news.title: Sam Bennett scores 200th career goal with 24 seconds left as Panthers beat Capitals 3-2
news.ruTitle: Sam Bennett scores 200th career goal with 24 seconds left as Panthers beat Capitals 3-2
news.description: — Sam Bennett scored with 24 seconds remaining, the 200th goal of his career, and the Florida Panthers rallied past the Washington Capitals 3-2 on Friday.

news.title: Flyers beat Canucks 5-2 after leading scorer Matvei Michkov is benched for 'internal team matter'
news.ruTitle: Flyers beat Canucks 5-2 after leading scorer Matvei Michkov is benched for 'internal team matter'
news.description: — Travis Konecny, Porter Martone and Tyson Foerster scored on the power play and the Flyers beat the Vancouver Canucks 5-2 Friday with Philadelphia leading scorer Matvei Michkov benched.

news.title: Senators top Lightning 6-2 in historic win for Linus Ullmark
news.ruTitle: Senators top Lightning 6-2 in historic win for Linus Ullmark
news.description: — Linus Ullmark stopped 18 shots, Michael Amadio had a goal and two assists and Tim Stutzle scored twice as the Ottawa Senators defeated the Tampa Bay Lightning 6-2 on Friday.

news.title: Short-handed Chicago Blackhawks place Patrick Kane, 38, on injured reserve
news.ruTitle: Short-handed Chicago Blackhawks place Patrick Kane, 38, on injured reserve
news.description: In a move that was made retroactive to Wednesday, the Chicago Blackhawks placed forward Patrick Kane, 38, on injured reserve because of a lower-body injury before Friday's game against the Rangers and recalled forward Landon Slaggert from AHL Rockford.

news.title: Gibson records 29th career shutout as Red Wings beat the Blue Jackets 2-0
news.ruTitle: Gibson records 29th career shutout as Red Wings beat the Blue Jackets 2-0
news.description: — J.T. Compher and Alex DeBrincat scored, and John Gibson made 18 saves for his 29th career shutout as the Detroit Red Wings beat Columbus 2-0 Friday, sending the Blue Jackets to their fifth consecutive home loss.

news.title: Kaskimaki's go-ahead goal helps Blues to 5-3 win over Stars
news.ruTitle: Kaskimaki's go-ahead goal helps Blues to 5-3 win over Stars
news.description: — Aleksanteri Kaskimaki's goal in the third period put the St. Louis Blues ahead for good in a 5-3 victory over the Dallas Stars on Friday afternoon.

news.title: Connor Brown's third-period goal lifts Devils to a 5-3 comeback win over Flames
news.ruTitle: Connor Brown's third-period goal lifts Devils to a 5-3 comeback win over Flames
news.description: — Connor Brown scored the go-ahead goal off a scramble in front with 3:58 remaining to lead the New Jersey Devils to a come-from-behind 5-3 win over the Calgary Flames on Friday.
